title: Krea-2 Turbo, text to image
description: A picture from a prompt with Krea 2 Turbo in 8 steps, with two switches: Enhance prompt (rewrites the prompt with a text model first) and Style LoRA (a Krea 2 style LoRA plus its trigger word; Dark Brush is set). Both are off by default. Krea 2 Community License: commercial use only under USD 1 M yearly revenue; deployments must filter content (https://krea.ai/krea-2-licensing). The preview was made with Fugue and this template.
